rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account via tools, then retrieved user details and order details before acting. It identified the only delivered order as eligible for return and correctly listed the items. The agent asked for explicit confirmation of the exact items to return and the refund destination, then sought a final confirmation before executing the return—satisfying the requirement to confirm before any write. The return was processed using the correct item IDs and the user’s PayPal method from their account. Afterward, the agent provided a refund breakdown that matches the item prices shown in the tools and a total consistent with those amounts. No actions were taken on another account, no unsupported claims were made, and the final information appears correct. Minor uncertainty about taxes/shipping is not indicated by policy/tools here and does not contradict the provided tool data.
